title: Relationship Record v2.2
description: UUID-endpoint relationship record for normalized model 2.2. Topology verbs and core semantic types including consumes_interface and composed_of are version-aware core vocabulary.

uuid_endpoint.description: Canonical entity UUID endpoint. TOPO handles (TOPO-*) are forbidden — topology-local addressing remains in authoring only.

topology_relationship_verb.description: Authored physical-system topology relationship verb normalized as compatibility records with explicit provenance.

core_relationship_type.description: Core normalized relationship type. Includes topology verbs (calls, publishes_to, subscribes_to, reads_from, writes_to, depends_on). consumes_interface denotes interface consumption between components when directly authored. composed_of denotes system-to-component membership (SYS UUID to COMP UUID) derived from explicit PS topology component_ref membership, not TOPO-shaped endpoints.

relationship_type.description: Compatibility relationship type. Core v2.2 vocabulary includes topology verbs (calls, publishes_to, subscribes_to, reads_from, writes_to, depends_on), consumes_interface (interface consumption between components), and composed_of (system-to-component membership from explicit PS topology). TOPO handles must not appear as endpoints.
